candidates.label: Air handler supplying wrong air temperature
candidates.detail: The central air handler delivers air at the wrong temperature: cooling coil or chilled-water valve failed, economizer stuck open on a hot day, discharge setpoint or reset too warm, or the unit stuck in heating or warm-up mode. Airflow at every box can be perfectly normal while the rooms cannot be cooled.

check.name: bas_supply_air_temp
check.text: In the control system read the air handler discharge air temperature against its setpoint, and the air temperature entering the box. Abnormal if it is more than about 3 F above the cooling setpoint (or the unit is in heating or warm-up mode).

candidates.label: Restriction in the branch duct ahead of the box
candidates.detail: Between the main duct and the box inlet there is a closed or partly closed manual balancing damper, a tripped or closed fire or smoke damper, or a crushed or kinked inlet flex duct. Main static at the air handler is fine, but the box is starved.

check.name: inlet_branch_inspect
check.text: Trace the branch duct from the main to the box inlet: check the manual volume damper position, the fire or smoke damper blades (open, not tripped), and the inlet flex for kinks or collapse. Abnormal if any is closed or restricted.

candidates.label: Operator override left on a control point
candidates.detail: Someone forced a damper position, airflow setpoint, zone setpoint or mode in the control system (priority-array override, commissioning or test leftover) and never released it. The controller obeys the forced value, so everything downstream looks consistent.

check.name: bas_override_scan
check.text: In the control system look at the priority array or override flags on the box's damper, airflow setpoint, cooling and heating setpoints and mode points. Abnormal if any point is held by an operator or manual override.

candidates.label: Fan-powered box local fan or backdraft damper failed
candidates.detail: On a series or parallel fan-powered box the local induction fan has failed, its relay, SCR or motor is bad, or its backdraft damper is stuck. Primary air may be fine but total delivered air and mixing are lost, especially in heating.

check.name: box_fan_run
check.text: At the box command the local fan on and listen and look: does the fan run, draw current, and does the backdraft damper open? Abnormal if the fan is dead, not turning or the damper stays shut.

candidates.label: Return or transfer air path blocked
candidates.detail: Supply air cannot leave the room: closed door with no undercut or transfer grille, blocked return grille, or an exhaust fighting the supply, so the room pressurizes and delivered airflow and mixing drop.

check.name: return_path_check
check.text: In the room check the return or transfer grille for blockage and test room pressure with the door closed (door whistles, hard to open, or air pushes out at the gap). Abnormal if the return path is blocked or the room is clearly pressurized.
